brandName: Google & Google DeepMind Unified Brand System

identityEvolutionPillars.pillar: 1. Scalable Geometric Mark (Logotype, Dots, G Emblem & Gemini Sparkle)
identityEvolutionPillars.principle: Constructed from pure mathematical geometry so the mark remains legible from 16px favicons and watch faces to wall-sized data center displays.
identityEvolutionPillars.implementationInCarbon: Implemented via pure SVG bezier & radial gradient vectors in assets/brand/deepmind-mark.svg and assets/brand/gemini-sparkle.svg.

identityEvolutionPillars.principle: Visual elements respond to user intent, voice input, thinking phases, and streaming token generation with physics-grounded continuity.
identityEvolutionPillars.implementationInCarbon: Real-time compute telemetry feedback across /api/gemma-step, /api/bench, and Dawn WebGPU shader compilation.

identityEvolutionPillars.pillar: 3. Systematic Cross-Product Branding (Product Sans / Google Sans)
identityEvolutionPillars.principle: Unifies hardware, Workspace, Cloud, and DeepMind research interfaces under a single geometric typographic lockup.
identityEvolutionPillars.implementationInCarbon: Enforced via --font-display ('Google Sans' / 'Product Sans'), --font-body ('Google Sans Text'), and --font-mono ('Google Sans Mono').

identityEvolutionPillars.principle: Uses Hue-Chroma-Tone (HCT / CAM16) perceptual color space to guarantee WCAG AAA contrast across dark and high-density technical dashboards.
identityEvolutionPillars.implementationInCarbon: Surface hierarchy (--surface-0 #060911 through --surface-3 #182238) paired with high-luminance #F8FAFC and #8AB4F8 text tokens.
